title: crataegus × dispessa
intro: Crataegus × dispessa, commonly known as a hybrid hawthorn plant, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to support cardiovascular health, and its health benefits include lowering blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as improving circulation and reducing the risk of heart disease. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus × dispessa include vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its cardiotonic and cardioprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
